messages:
alex_support: FYI acme reported that 3 users can't access the model sandbox or billing pages after last night's RBAC rollout. getting 403 on model access and `billing.project.view` denied. :warning:

sara_csm: customer says they were in role `acme-developer` and used the console fine until ~02:10 UTC. now the console shows limited menus. they're blocked from launching models and can't view invoices. they're on Dedicated.

alex_support: I grabbed the console logs from the user session: `permission denied: missing policy allow:model.deploy for principal user:U123` and `permission denied: billing.view` in the same time window. attaching small snippet: ```json
{"ts": "2026-03-18T02:12:03Z", "principal": "U123", "resource": "projects/acme/models/sandbox-1", "action": "model.deploy", "result": "DENY", "source": "rolesync"}```

maria_security: :eyes: initial thought: role prefixing change we shipped last night (rolesync v2) changes precedence between org-scoped and platform-scoped roles. could be role-shadowing where the new `platform-admin` group overwrote tenant-specific mappings.

devon_infra: I can repro in staging with the new rolesync config. If a user is in both `acme-developer` and `platform-admin-lite` the sync now binds the platform role last and it becomes the effective set, which lacks tenant model permissions. looks like a bug in merge logic.

alex_support: so this explains both model and billing denies?

maria_security: yes. platform-* roles are intentionally narrow for hosted infra ops but the precedence flip removed previously granted tenant perms. billing roles are evaluated the same path.

sara_csm: customer is escalated. they need temporary access ASAP. what can we do that is safe?

devon_infra: short term workaround: explicitly grant `acme-developer` as a direct role on the org (bypass sync) or add a temporary exception that forces tenant role dominance. I can patch a sync override for their tenant only.

maria_security: prefer the least blast radius. apply a per-tenant override and create an audit entry. ops-bot: can you open INC and annotate which tenants we touch?

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1145. Assigned to devon_infra, priority: P1.

devon_infra: applied manual override for tenant `acme` at 02:45 UTC to restore `acme-developer` precedence. confirm from customer?

sara_csm: acme confirms access restored at 02:52 UTC. they can view billing and deploy to sandbox again. :white_check_mark:

alex_support: next steps to prevent recurrence?

maria_security: rollback rolesync v2 to v1 for production immediately and schedule a code fix. we need safer merge semantics and unit tests for precedence. also add a canary that exercises dual-membership edge cases.

devon_infra: rolling back now. will keep the manual tenant override until we've validated new merge logic. also adding audit log flag so we can query `rolesync.v2.change` entries.

maria_security: can we also print the effective role set in audit logs for five minutes after a sync so we can trace regressions?

devon_infra: yes, adding an ephemeral debug dump to Splunk for the next hour. query name: `rolesync_effective_roles` with tenant and principal.

alex_support: follow-up items: 1) patch rolesync merge logic (maria/devon) 2) postmortem and customer communication (sara/alex) 3) add unit/integration tests and canary (devon) 4) ensure manual overrides expire automatically or are tracked (maria).

sara_csm: I'll draft a customer note and send to acme legal/comms for sign-off. we should offer post-incident call if they'd like.

maria_security: tagging this as security-impacting because access rules changed; we'll run a quick vuln triage to ensure no unintended privilege escalation went the other way.

devon_infra: rollback completed at 03:10 UTC. rolesync v1 active. manual override scheduled to auto-expire in 72h unless explicitly extended.

alex_support: thanks everyone. I'll close the support ticket once the postmortem and comms are out. adding link to incident: https://rwinf.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1145

sara_csm: customer feedback: appreciated the quick patch; requested a timeline for permanent fix and assurance about auditability. I'll include the audit indices and rollback timeline in the note.

maria_security: I'll own the postmortem write-up and include remediation timeline: fix in next patch (canary in staging within 24h, prod rollout next week), plus added tests and logging.

alex_support: captured. closing loop once postmortem published. :lock:
